measurements.name: Jutland Current
measurements.range_interpretation: Report describes a 10-20 km surface-water-mass breadth in a regional geographic synthesis. Not paired velocity boundaries, a confidence interval, annual extrema or a whole-current width.
measurements.geographic_scope: Surface water mass along the west Jutland coast from Henne Strand north of Horns Rev to Skagen; Wadden Sea offshore traceability and habitat zones have separate support.
measurements.section_orientation: Reported coastal water-mass breadth; no transverse velocity section or paired geographic edges extracted.
measurements.layer: Surface water mass; fixed numerical depth bounds not supplied for this breadth.
measurements.time_convention: Undated regional synthesis in a report approved September 2019. December 2018 modeled maps and seasonal seabird distributions do not date the width statement.
measurements.boundary_rule: Report-provided water-mass breadth citing Nielsen (1999); salinity threshold, paired edges and underlying width method remain unresolved.
measurements.source_citation: Skov, Mortensen and Tuhuteru (2019), Site selection for offshore wind farms in Danish waters: Investigations of bird distribution and abundance, DHI for Energistyrelsen / Danish Energy Agency, project 11823165, final approved 18 September 2019.
measurements.source_locator: Section 2.3, printed p15 / PDF p27 (10-20 km); PDF p26 preceding oceanographic context; Figure 6 PDF p28; section 3.1.1.1 printed pp23-24 / PDF pp35-36 distinguishes habitat and alternate reach; title/credits PDF pp1,3.
measurements.extraction_method: Reported breadth span transcribed from visually inspected original prose. No map digitization, salinity contour diagnosis or velocity-core inference.
measurements.source_quality_note: Agency-hosted DHI geographic water-mass synthesis. Nielsen thesis reprint now inspected at selected pages: separate 40, 25 and 20-25 km satellite-image estimates cite Aarup (1994a). Exact DHI 10-20 km phrase not confirmed in the reviewed Nielsen width passage. Original imagery methods and North/South label relations remain unresolved.
remaining_gates: Recover Nielsen (1999) and the underlying water-mass boundary definition.
Resolve North/South Jutland label relations independently of this regional breadth.
Recover compatible repeated sections, dates, depth and geographic edges before seasonal widths or mapped bands.

original_regional_context.display_caption: Jutland: reported 10-20 km coastal surface-water-mass breadth from Henne Strand to Skagen. Not a velocity-core width, confidence interval or seasonal range. No mapped width edges.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Surface-water-mass synthesis. The inspected Nielsen thesis gives separate site-specific satellite estimates citing unreviewed Aarup (1994a); this review does not corroborate the exact 10-20 km phrase. Offshore traceability, core confinement, bird habitat and December 2018 model maps remain separate support. No pooled seasonal range or resolved North/South aliases.
